schema.name: phileas_overview
schema.description:
Parcels on their way with estimated arrival, today, needs attention. Mis envíos y cuándo llegan.
Active shipments sorted by estimated day, what arrives today, problems (incidence, failed attempt, pickup waiting, late), deliveries of the last week, notifications since the last visit. Sinónimos: paquetes, pedidos, seguimiento, qué me llega, cuándo llega, envíos pendientes, tracking.

schema.name: phileas_status
schema.description:
Health: mail source, carrier sources, channels, scheduler, settings. Estado de Phileas.
Sinónimos: configuración, claves, canales de aviso, último escaneo de correo.

schema.name: shipments_list
schema.description:
List shipments (active, delivered, all, archived, history) with filters. Lista de envíos.
Sinónimos: buscar envío, pedidos de Amazon, paquetes de UPS, historial.

text.description: Matches label, item, shop, tracking number or order number.
text.title: Text

schema.name: shipment_get
schema.description:
One shipment: status, estimate, carrier events, mails, similar parcels. Detalle de un envío.
Accepts the id, the tracking number or the order number. Sinónimos: dónde está mi paquete, seguimiento de X.

shipment.description: Shipment id (s_…), tracking number or order number.
shipment.title: Shipment

schema.name: shipment_add
schema.description:
Track a parcel by its tracking number (carrier guessed if empty). Añadir seguimiento a mano.
Sinónimos: sigue este número, añade este envío, tracking.

carrier.description: ups, correos, dhl, seur, gls, mrw, nacex, ctt, inpost, fedex, yunexpress… Empty = guess.
carrier.title: Carrier

schema.name: shipment_update
schema.description:
Edit a shipment: label, carrier, number, notes, archive, mute, status. Editar envío.
Sinónimos: renombrar, silenciar avisos, archivar, marcar como entregado.

origin_country.description: ISO country the parcel leaves from, e.g. NL.
origin_country.title: Origin Country

status.description: Set by hand: ordered, label_created, not_found, in_transit, customs, out_for_delivery, available_for_pickup, failed_attempt, exception, delivered, returned, unknown.
status.title: Status

schema.name: shipment_delete
schema.description: Delete a shipment and its events (confirm=true). Borrar envío.

schema.name: shipment_received
schema.description: Mark received: stop tracking, clear its alerts and keep it in history. Recibido.

shipment.description: Shipment id (s_…), tracking number or order number.
shipment.title: Shipment

schema.name: shipment_reopen
schema.description: Undo a manual receipt and resume its previous status. Volver a seguir.

shipment.description: Shipment id (s_…), tracking number or order number.
shipment.title: Shipment

schema.name: shipment_merge
schema.description: Merge two shipments that are the same parcel (confirm=true). Fusionar envíos duplicados.

schema.name: shipment_refresh
schema.description:
Ask the carrier now for one shipment. Comprobar ya un envío.
Sinónimos: actualiza, mira cómo va, refresca el seguimiento.

shipment.description: Shipment id (s_…), tracking number or order number.
shipment.title: Shipment

schema.name: eta_explain
schema.description:
Why the estimated date: sources used, carrier track record, similar past parcels. Explicar la fecha estimada.
Sinónimos: cuándo llega, por qué esa fecha, envíos parecidos, retraso.

shipment.description: Shipment id (s_…), tracking number or order number.
shipment.title: Shipment

schema.name: mail_scan
schema.description:
Read new shipping mail now (or search back N days / a query). Leer el correo ya.
Sinónimos: revisa el correo, busca el correo de la tienda, importar pedidos.

since_days.description: How far back to read (default: the configured window).
since_days.title: Since Days

query.description: Optional search, e.g. a shop name or a tracking number.
query.title: Query

reprocess.description: Re-read previously scanned messages to reconcile missed deliveries without duplicating parcels.
reprocess.title: Reprocess

schema.name: shipments_history_repair
schema.description:
Move old stuck parcels to the history (dry run first). Limpiar envíos antiguos del listado activo.
Parcels whose newest mail, carrier event and change are older than mail.history_days (default 30) and that are not delivered or archived go to the history quietly. dry_run=true (default) only lists them. Sinónimos: envíos viejos activos, limpiar historial, reparar envíos.

dry_run.description: Only report what would move to the history (default). Pass false to do it.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

schema.name: mail_list
schema.description: Mails Phileas read: to review (maybe), shipping, noise. Correos leídos y dudosos.

schema.name: mail_accept
schema.description: Turn a doubtful mail into a shipment update. Aceptar correo dudoso como envío.

schema.name: mail_ignore
schema.description: Ignore a doubtful mail. Ignorar correo dudoso.

schema.name: mail_paste
schema.description: File a shipping mail pasted as text (shops outside the inbox). Pegar un correo de envío.

text.description: The mail body as plain text.
text.title: Text

schema.name: mail_status
schema.description: Which inbox Phileas reads (account in Faustus) and whether it answers. Estado del correo.

schema.name: detect_numbers
schema.description: Find tracking numbers and carriers in any text. Detectar números de seguimiento.

schema.name: track_number
schema.description: One-off lookup of a tracking number without saving it. Consultar un número sin guardarlo.

schema.name: delivery_stats
schema.description:
Delivery days per carrier and shop on past parcels, and how accurate their dates were. Estadísticas.
Sinónimos: cuánto tarda UPS, qué transportista es más rápido, retrasos habituales.

schema.name: carriers_list
schema.description: Known carriers and which source answers for each. Transportistas y fuentes.

schema.name: notifications_list
schema.description: Notifications sent (newest first). Avisos enviados.

schema.name: notify_status
schema.description: Notification channels: toast, hub, ntfy, Telegram, email. Canales de aviso.

schema.name: notify_test
schema.description: Send a test notification through one channel or the family hub. Probar un canal de aviso.

via.description: hub = a sample notification through the family hub's notification centre (it decides the channels); own = test the channel itself.
via.title: Via

schema.name: telegram_find_chat_id
schema.description: Find and save the Telegram chat id after writing to the bot. Buscar chat de Telegram.

schema.name: settings_set
schema.description: Change settings (mail source, alert delivery, mail interval, holidays region, channels…). Cambiar ajustes.

values.description: Setting key -> value. See phileas_status → settings for the keys.
values.title: Values

schema.name: secret_set
schema.description: Store a key (17TRACK, UPS, DHL, Telegram, ntfy, SMTP). Guardar una clave.

schema.name: scheduler_status
schema.description: Background jobs: lanes, queue, last mail scan. Estado del planificador.

schema.name: runs_list
schema.description: Recent mail scans and carrier checks with their result. Últimas comprobaciones.

schema.name: housekeeping_run
schema.description: Archive old deliveries, flag stale parcels, pickup reminders, refresh estimates. Mantenimiento.

schema.name: travel_overview
schema.description:
Trips on now, next trip, check-ins to do, mails to review. Mis viajes de un vistazo.
What is happening today on a trip in progress, the next trip with days to go, flights whose online check-in is open or about to open, bookings from mail waiting for review and counts. Sinónimos: viajes, qué viaje tengo, mi próximo viaje, qué hago hoy de viaje, check-in pendiente.

schema.name: trips_list
schema.description:
List trips (upcoming, ongoing, past, cancelled, all). Lista de viajes.
Each trip has title, dates, destination, status, days to go, kinds of segments and what needs review. Sinónimos: mis viajes, viajes pasados, viajes cancelados, cuándo es mi próximo viaje.

schema.name: trip_get
schema.description:
One trip: segments, day-by-day timeline, links, people, expenses and balances. Detalle de un viaje.
Takes the trip id or its exact title. Segments carry check-in state, times with their time zone and the mails they came from. Sinónimos: vuelos de mi viaje, dónde me alojo, a qué hora sale, itinerario, enlaces de la reserva.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: trip_create
schema.description:
Create a trip by hand with a title and dates. Crear un viaje.
Sinónimos: nuevo viaje, apunta un viaje, viaje sin reservas.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; filled from the segments once there are some.
start_date.title: Start Date

currency.description: Base currency of the trip's shared expenses.
currency.title: Currency

schema.name: trip_update
schema.description:
Rename, mute, cancel, merge, split a trip or move a segment between trips. Editar un viaje.
merge_from (confirm=true) merges another trip into this one; split_segments moves some segments into a new trip; move_segment + to_trip moves one segment ('new' = its own trip, empty = let the grouping place it); delete (confirm=true) removes the trip and its bookings (keep_segments=true keeps them without a trip). Sinónimos: renombrar viaje, unir viajes, separar viaje, mover vuelo a otro viaje, silenciar avisos del viaje.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

title.description: Rename. An empty string gives the automatic title back.
title.title: Title

pinned.description: Keep the trip even with no segments.
pinned.title: Pinned

cancelled.description: Mark the whole trip cancelled (or not).
cancelled.title: Cancelled

merge_from.description: Another trip (id or title) to merge INTO this one; needs confirm=true.
merge_from.title: Merge From

split_segments.description: Segment ids to split off into a new trip (not all of them).
split_segments.title: Split Segments

split_title.description: Title for the trip created by split_segments.
split_title.title: Split Title

to_trip.description: With move_segment: target trip id or title, 'new' for a trip of its own, or empty to let the grouping place it again.
to_trip.title: To Trip

delete.description: Delete the trip AND its bookings (they are remembered as deleted, so reading the same mail again does not bring them back); needs confirm=true.
delete.title: Delete

keep_segments.description: With delete: keep the bookings instead, detached and marked 'no trip' (the grouping leaves them alone).
keep_segments.title: Keep Segments

schema.name: segment_add
schema.description:
Add a flight, train, bus, ferry, car rental, stay or activity by hand. Añadir un tramo o reserva.
Times are local at the place; the airport table fills the city and time zone from IATA codes. Sinónimos: añade un vuelo, apunta un hotel, añadir reserva, he comprado un billete de tren, alquiler de coche.

number.description: Flight number like IB3166, train number or bus line.
number.title: Number

provider.description: Hotel, rental company or host (stays and cars).
provider.title: Provider

from_name.description: Station, port, pick-up point or the stay's name.
from_name.title: From Name

dep_local.description: Departure, check-in or pick-up. Local time at the place, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (or just YYYY-MM-DD).
dep_local.title: Dep Local

arr_local.description: Arrival, check-out or drop-off. Local time at the place, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (or just YYYY-MM-DD).
arr_local.title: Arr Local

dep_tz.description: IANA zone of the departure place; filled from the airport when empty.
dep_tz.title: Dep Tz

kind.description: flight, train, bus, ferry, car (rental), lodging or event.
kind.title: Kind

trip.description: Trip id or title to put it in; empty lets the grouping decide.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: segment_update
schema.description:
Edit a segment: times, places, number, seat, terminal, price, status. Editar un tramo.
Sinónimos: cambiar hora del vuelo, cambiar asiento, corregir fecha, el hotel es otro, marcar como cancelado.

number.description: Flight number like IB3166, train number or bus line.
number.title: Number

provider.description: Hotel, rental company or host (stays and cars).
provider.title: Provider

from_name.description: Station, port, pick-up point or the stay's name.
from_name.title: From Name

dep_local.description: Departure, check-in or pick-up. Local time at the place, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (or just YYYY-MM-DD).
dep_local.title: Dep Local

arr_local.description: Arrival, check-out or drop-off. Local time at the place, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (or just YYYY-MM-DD).
arr_local.title: Arr Local

dep_tz.description: IANA zone of the departure place; filled from the airport when empty.
dep_tz.title: Dep Tz

segment.description: Segment id (g_…); the ids are in trip_get.
segment.title: Segment

schema.name: segment_delete
schema.description: Delete a segment (confirm=true). Borrar un tramo o reserva.

segment.description: Segment id (g_…); the ids are in trip_get.
segment.title: Segment

schema.name: checkin_status
schema.description:
Online check-in window of each flight: opens, closes, link, done or not. Estado del check-in.
Uses the airline table verified 02-10-2026 and says its source; an airline not in the table is reported as unknown. Sinónimos: cuándo abre el check-in, puedo hacer ya el check-in, check-in online, hora límite del check-in.

trip.description: Only this trip's flights; empty = flights in the next 45 days.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: checkin_done
schema.description:
Mark a flight's check-in as done (or not). Check-in hecho.
Sinónimos: ya hice el check-in, marcar check-in, deshacer check-in.

segment.description: Segment id (g_…); the ids are in trip_get.
segment.title: Segment

schema.name: trip_documents_check
schema.description:
Will the ID card or passport in Kafka still be valid when the trip ends? Comprobar documentos.
Asks Kafka through the hub; if Kafka is down the status is unknown, never an error. Document numbers are never shown. Sinónimos: caduca mi pasaporte, DNI en regla para viajar, documentos para el viaje.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: trip_people
schema.description:
People sharing the trip's expenses: add, rename, remove, which one is the user. Personas del viaje.
Sinónimos: añade a Marta al viaje, quién viaja, yo soy.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

remove.description: Names to remove (only if they are in no expense).
remove.title: Remove

me.description: Which of the people is the user.
me.title: Me

schema.name: trip_expenses
schema.description:
A trip's shared expenses with each person's share, balances and transfers. Gastos del viaje.
Sinónimos: gastos compartidos, cuánto llevamos gastado, quién debe a quién, cuentas del viaje.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: trip_expense_add
schema.description:
Add a shared expense: who paid, split equal/shares/exact, currency with its rate. Añadir gasto del viaje.
from_segment turns a booking's price into one expense. Another currency than the trip's needs the rate you paid. Sinónimos: he pagado la cena, apunta un gasto del viaje, pagó Marta, dividir a partes iguales.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

amount.description: Amount paid in `currency` (the trip currency by default).
amount.title: Amount

rate.description: 1 unit of `currency` in the trip currency; required when they differ (never fetched from the network).
rate.title: Rate

split.description: equal: {"people": [names]} (default everybody); shares: {"shares": {name: weight}}; exact: {"amounts": {name: amount}} adding up to the amount.
split.title: Split

from_segment.description: Instead of description/amount: the price found in that segment's mail, as one expense.
from_segment.title: From Segment

schema.name: trip_expense_update
schema.description: Change a shared expense. Editar gasto del viaje.

schema.name: trip_expense_delete
schema.description: Delete a shared expense (confirm=true). Borrar gasto del viaje.

schema.name: trip_settle
schema.description:
Balances and the fewest transfers that settle a trip's expenses. Saldar cuentas del viaje.
Sinónimos: quién paga a quién, repartir gastos, liquidar el viaje, cuánto me deben.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: trip_to_ledger
schema.description:
Send my share of each trip expense not yet sent to Ledger. Pasar mi parte a Ledger.
Each expense goes once (remembered); Ledger down or an account in another currency is explained, nothing is invented. dry_run lists what would go. Sinónimos: pasa los gastos del viaje a mis cuentas, apunta mi parte en Ledger, registrar gastos del viaje.

trip.description: Trip id (t_…) or its exact title.
trip.title: Trip

account.description: Ledger account; default the travel.ledger_account setting, or the only account.
account.title: Account

dry_run.description: Only list what would be sent.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

schema.name: trip_ics
schema.description:
Export a trip (or every upcoming trip) to a calendar .ics file. Exportar al calendario.
One event per segment with its time zone, and an alarm when online check-in opens. Saved under data/exports. Sinónimos: añadir el viaje al calendario, exportar a ics, calendario de viajes.

trip.description: One trip; empty = every upcoming and ongoing trip.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: trip_paste
schema.description:
Read a booking mail pasted as text into segments and trips. Pegar un correo de reserva.
Reads schema.org markup, sender rules or the local model; says what was read and what needs review. Sinónimos: pega este correo de vuelo, lee esta confirmación de hotel, añadir reserva desde un email.

text.description: The booking mail as plain text.
text.title: Text

from_address.description: Sender address, when known: it helps pick the right rules.
from_address.title: From Address

trip.description: Put what is read into this trip.
trip.title: Trip

schema.name: travel_mail_list
schema.description:
Travel mails read: waiting for review, filed, ignored. Correos de viajes leídos.
Each shows what was read (source schema, rules or model, with evidence lines). Accept with mail_accept, ignore with mail_ignore. Sinónimos: correos de reservas pendientes, qué reservas ha leído.

schema.name: travel_mail_read_again
schema.description: Ask the local model to read a travel mail from the review list again. Releer reserva con el modelo.

schema.name: travel_mail_recheck
schema.description:
Drop non-bookings from the travel review list. Limpiar la lista de revisión de viajes.
Runs the booking-evidence check again over the mails waiting for review and moves marketing, notices and event tickets out of the list. Sinónimos: limpiar correos de viajes, quitar publicidad de la lista de reservas.
